channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: SUPERGIRL: Milly Alcock's Performance Likened To That Of MCU's Chris Evans And Robert Downey Jr.
item.description: Early word from Supergirl test screenings has seen Milly Alock receive the lion's share of praise, and this latest leak points to her stealing the show in more ways than one.

item.title: RUMOR: SPIDER-MAN 5 Director Revealed; Update On BRAND NEW DAY Trailer Release And Sadie Sink's Role
item.description: New Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumours reveal an update on the movie's trailer and a big scene involving Sadie Sink. We also have news on plans for Spider-Man 5's director.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Finds Its Footing At The Box Office Over Christmas Ahead Of Another Huge Weekend
item.description: After a slow start, it seems Avatar: Fire and Ash has found its footing at both the domestic and international box offices. Could $2 billion be back on the table for the threequel?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: The Runtime For Trailer #4 Has Been Revealed As X-MEN Teaser Is Sent Out To Theaters
item.description: As the third Avengers: Doomsday teaser is sent out to theaters, we have confirmed runtimes for that and the fourth and final sneak peek heading our way next month.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: SECRET WARS To Feature Spider-Man, Wolverine, And More In Lead Roles - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: A new report claims to reveal four of the main characters in 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars, and it seems some dream team-ups are on the horizon for Marvel fans.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY And SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Are 2026's Most Anticipated Movies According To Google
item.description: Based on search data from Google, Avengers: Doomsday and Spider-Man: Brand New Day are 2026's most highly anticipated comic book movies, easily topping Supergirl and Clayface.

item.title: RUMOR: We Finally Know Why Jean Grey Won't Appear In AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY - SPOILERS
item.description: X-Men star Famke Janssen has repeatedly said she won't be part of Avengers: Doomsday, and a new rumour claims to reveal the shocking reason for the character's absence.

item.title: March's DEATH SPIRAL Issues Continue The Countdown To AMAZING SPIDER-MAN #1000 With More Shocks And Surprises
item.description: This March, Death Spiral, the new Spider-Man/Venom/Carnage crossover from Joe Kelly, Al Ewing, Charles Soule, Ed McGuinness, Jesús Saíz, and Carlos Gómez, continues, and we have a first look.
